tEn: Building the Future: Paul Graham & Amjad Masad on Vibe Coding and AI Agents
tZh: 构建未来：Paul Graham 与 Amjad Masad 谈氛围编程与 AI 智能体
sEn: Amjad Masad joins Paul Graham to trace how Replit turned manual ChatGPT copy-paste loops into autonomous AI agents that write, debug, and deploy code.
sZh: Amjad Masad 与 Paul Graham 对谈，回顾 Replit 如何把用户手动复制粘贴 ChatGPT 代码的流程，变成能自主编写、调试并部署代码的 AI 智能体。

consensus.en: AI coding will force everyone through denial, depression, then acceptance; adaptability is the key skill.
consensus.zh: AI 编程将迫使所有人经历否认、沮丧再到接受；适应力是关键能力。

consensus.en: Replit's moat is deep systems engineering: sandboxing, deployment, and a transactional file system.
consensus.zh: Replit 的护城河是深度系统级工程：沙箱、部署和事务性文件系统。

consensus.en: Running LLMs to completion—looping until the program works—was Replit's key early demonstration.
consensus.zh: 让 LLM 运行至完成——循环直到程序可用——是 Replit 早期的关键演示。

consensus.en: AI is a constant commoditization force; companies must continuously reinvent and do the next thing.
consensus.zh: AI 是持续的 commoditization 力量；公司必须不断重塑、做下一件事。

consensus.en: The next vision is the self-driving company: Replit as the platform for AI-driven organizational transformation.
consensus.zh: 下一个愿景是自驱动公司：Replit 作为 AI 驱动组织转型的平台。

consensus.en: Superlinear returns: making programming 10% easier yields far more than 10% more programmers.
consensus.zh: 超线性回报：编程难度降低 10%，带来的程序员数量远超 10%。

contrarian.en: Vibe coding wasn't a sudden leap; users were already 50-60% AI-assisted before the launch.
contrarian.zh: Vibe coding 并非突然飞跃；发布前用户已实现 50-60% 的 AI 辅助编程。

contrarian.en: The early harness was 10x more complex than today's because models were far less capable.
contrarian.zh: 早期 harness 比今天复杂 10 倍，因为模型能力远不如现在。

contrarian.en: Token rationing is wrong; companies should measure ROI, since one person can drive 100x another.
contrarian.zh: 按 token 配额分配是错的；公司应衡量 ROI，因为人与人之间产出可差 100 倍。

contrarian.en: Most banks still use a barely-connected 2023-era LLM; Silicon Valley vastly underestimates this lag.
contrarian.zh: 多数银行仍在使用几乎未连接的 2023 年 LLM；硅谷严重低估了这一滞后。

contrarian.en: Compute brought on AI, not the other way around; deep learning needed massive compute to work.
contrarian.zh: 是算力带来了 AI，而非相反；深度学习需要海量算力才奏效。

contrarian.en: The safest place in an approaching tidal wave is surfing it, not clinging to a palm tree.
contrarian.zh: 面对逼近的海啸，最安全的位置是冲浪，而不是抱住棕榈树。
